"text": "Use this workflow to request, organize, and route divorce-related planning documents for analysis for Nadia Pebblefizz. "title": "Confirm document scope and permissions",
"text": "Identify which documents are needed, such as draft or final settlement terms, asset schedules, support obligations, retirement account orders, tax returns, and current statements. Confirm the client’s written permission before coordinating with an attorney, CPA, or mediator.",
"priority": "high",
"assigneeId": "566065b0-a2b0-53ae-ab9b-e451b9b96dd5"
},
{
"title": "Create secure collection folder",
"text": "Set up a secure upload location, list missing items, and label received documents by category. Do not request or store unnecessary sensitive documents beyond the planning scope.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "405a0bba-bb14-5076-904a-cb26172e4fcb"
},
{
"title": "Prepare planning summary for advisor review",
"text": "Summarize available assets, liabilities, income obligations, beneficiary concerns, account titling issues, and open questions for the advisor. Flag any urgent implementation constraints without providing legal conclusions.",
"priority": "medium",
"assigneeId": "9268210f-ef66-5a4b-88ad-788a4cfe5d2d"
}
],
"evidence": "They agreed by 2026-07-17 to coordinate with attorney Corin Nettlewhisk and CPA Jules Thimblefern after written authorization, with a planning packet covering draft settlement terms, asset schedules, support estimates, retirement-account order questions, and current statements."
},
